name: LunaHolistic
reason: Health rule: the Reiki centre's own course pages (checked 4 Nov 2026) sell its training on conditions: the courses overview says a short session can profoundly shift chronic pain and trauma, and the Level I page says students released life-threatening addictions and depression for good; the About page also frames the work around anxiety and depression. It is also a multi-practitioner centre (founded by Geneva Robins) rather than one teacher.
